children.text: I'm a recent CS grad from CUNY CSI, freelancing in New York City. I build web apps for small businesses and wire them into the services they already use with the goal of automating and centralizing the work already being done.

In college I built projects mostly because they were fun to make, and then people started asking what they actually did. Now I aim for both: software that feels good to use and solves a real problem. AI tools are a big part of how I ship fast and catch bugs before they hit production.

Before this, I worked in IT at a managed services provider supporting creative agencies. I managed Windows and Mac devices end to end, supported Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, and automated processes like user onboarding. Before that, I worked on the fabrication and production side at an event design shop. When I'm not at the computer, I'm usually hiking or biking somewhere in the Northeast.
I'm currently looking for a full-time role in software, solutions, or IT, and I'd love to connect.
